actions.reason: K4_C0004 lacks positive evidence that its current membership is an independently represented unit. Its set-level geometry report shows essentially absent current-label alignment: near-zero or negative silhouettes in ct, rna, and wsi, and within-set distances exceeding between-set distances in every modality. Its pair-level boundary reports against K4_C0001 and K4_C0002 show the boundary is unrepresented in ct/rna/wsi (near-zero or negative silhouettes, within-versus-between reversed in ct), with separation confined to wxs alone; only the K4_C0003 pair shows weak but consistent separation, which is insufficient to establish independence. Its biological identity is also the weakest: the RNA enrichment report describes a comparatively weak, less coherent program with only a few pathways below q=0.05, and the WXS report gives a narrow VHL-enriched/PBRM1-depleted pattern based on only 13 patients with no gene surviving family-wide multiplicity control. The partition-level structural report additionally notes K4_C0004 is the smallest set with the least stable estimates. No structural revision is warranted: the partition screen shows no internal subdivision signal, and the weak pair boundaries do not justify merging K4_C0004 into any neighbor as a more defensible one-unit representation. Independent retention is therefore not positively justified.

K4_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: the RNA enrichment report shows a broad, coordinated down-shift of oxidative-phosphorylation, interferon, complement, allograft-rejection, and IL6/JAK/STAT3 programs with top programs at q=0.001, internally consistent across related immune and metabolic pathways. Its set-level geometry report shows weak but directionally consistent current-label alignment (within-set distances marginally below between-set for ct, rna, and wxs; largest silhouette in wxs), and its pair boundary against K4_C0004 is represented in wxs (silhouette 0.315) with within-set distances below between-set in rna, wsi, and wxs. The pair report's ct reversal and near-zero ct/rna/wsi silhouettes are noted, but the boundary is not absent across modalities and the candidate retains a distinct molecular program. No internal subdivision signal is present in the partition screen, and no specific neighbor is a plausible one-unit alternative. Independent retention is positively supported.

K4_C0002 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: the RNA enrichment report shows a broad, coordinated up-shift of oxidative-phosphorylation, protein-secretion, fatty-acid-metabolism, adipogenesis, mTORC1, and peroxisome programs with top programs at q=0.001, internally consistent across related metabolic pathways. Its set-level geometry report shows directionally consistent current-label alignment: within-set distances smaller than between-set in all four modalities, with the clearest separation in wxs (silhouette 0.177). Its pair boundary against K4_C0004 is represented in wxs (silhouette 0.246, within-set below between-set), though the report notes ct/rna/wsi are near zero. The boundary is not absent across modalities and the candidate retains a distinct metabolic program. No internal subdivision signal is present in the partition screen, and no specific neighbor is a plausible one-unit alternative. Independent retention is positively supported.

K4_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: the RNA enrichment report shows a broad, coordinated up-shift of immune/inflammatory programs (allograft rejection, interferon gamma and alpha, IL6/JAK/STAT3, inflammatory response, complement) with top programs at q=0.001, internally consistent across related immune pathways. Its set-level geometry report shows weak but directionally consistent current-label alignment (within-set distances smaller than between-set in all four modalities, largest silhouette in wsi). Its pair boundary against K4_C0004 is weakly but consistently represented: positive silhouettes in ct, rna, and wsi and moderate in wxs, with within-set distances below between-set in all four modalities. No internal subdivision signal is present in the partition screen, and no specific neighbor is a plausible one-unit alternative. Independent retention is positively supported.
